_comment: Chronological split of the available BTC/USDT 1h history. Confirmed via `docker compose run --rm freqtrade list-data --datadir /freqtrade/user_data/data/binance --show-timerange` on 2026-10-27: 8778 candles, 2025-10-20T00:00:00Z to 2026-10-20T17:00:00Z. Split is 60% exploration / 20% validation / 20% final test, computed chronologically on that confirmed range. Do not recompute from a different data pull without re-deriving these boundaries the same way.

final_test._note: runner.py must refuse to run this split while final_test_unlocked is false. Only the user may flip this flag.
